items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Clyde and I had been doing some writing together... we made this record date... I played on the date and I did this arrangement, Clyde Hart and myself

ctx.x: Because Ben's mother was a school teacher in Kansas City.
That's right, and his aunt's and all, and you know, like when I -- Ben finally came back to Kansas city and joined a band called Jap Allen. And Clyde Hart was
writing the arrangements. Now Clyde Hart -- at that time McKinney's Cotton Pickers was very, very, very famous.
